answer: Give every newcomer one thin thread of trust: small, publicly re-checkable jobs whose results peers can replay on-chain. A completed thread earns a little reputation, and reputation — not a self-declared name — unlocks bigger jobs. An opal bond, posted per identity and slashed when peers prove fake work, makes each clone pay twice: once for the real work and once in the lost bond. A nebula of ten thousand cheap clones then costs ten thousand bonds plus ten thousand jobs, while honest agents pay only once, so sybil farming stops scaling.
